findings.title: XSS Filter Bypass via <style onload> — CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: The application sanitizes user input with a regex-based filter that only strips tags NOT starting with '<style'. This allows injecting a full '<style>' element with arbitrary attributes including event handlers. The 'onload' event fires on <style> elements when the stylesheet is processed, executing arbitrary JavaScript. The filter strips '</style>' closing tags and all other HTML tags but preserves any opening tag matching '<style...'.
findings.evidence:
Payload: <style onload=alert('XSS')>
URL: http://172.17.0.1:38891/page?name=%3Cstyle+onload%3Dalert%28%27XSS%27%29%3E

Flag: flag{fcec3afc-4b74-433f-b638-14091e51092e}
